WITH annual_delivered AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTRING(order_delivered_customer_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as delivery_year,
        COUNT(*) as annual_volume
    FROM olist_orders 
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered' 
      AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(SUBSTRING(order_delivered_customer_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
    GROUP BY delivery_year
),
lowest_year AS (
    SELECT delivery_year
    FROM annual_delivered
    ORDER BY annual_volume ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
monthly_delivered AS (

        COUNT(*) as monthly_volume

      AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(SUBSTRING(order_delivered_customer_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = (SELECT delivery_year FROM lowest_year)
    GROUP BY delivery_month
)
SELECT MAX(monthly_volume) as highest_monthly_delivered_orders
FROM monthly_delivered
